mechanism_claims.claim_text: Temporin B has direct virucidal activity against HSV-1, with fixed-dose preincubation reducing viral titer and TEM showing loss or breakage of the viral envelope.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Temporin B (LLPIVGNLLKSLL-NH2) acting on HSV-1 virions
mechanism_claims.limitations: The primary direct mechanism is virion/envelope disruption. Postinfection and attachment effects are source-supported but not resolved to a single cellular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TB also partially affects early HSV-1 attachment/entry, postinfection replication, and cell-to-cell spread, but these are recorded as secondary context rather than a fully mapped host-cell mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: HSV-1 infection in Vero, HeLa S3, and HEK-293 cell assays treated with 20 ug/ml TB
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper hypothesizes possible host-cell or viral-life-cycle targets, but it does not identify a specific host molecular target for postinfection effects.
